dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh plant level daily generation capacity and outage log and national generation master database 2024 2026

description: These linked Zenodo records digitise the daily operational logs of Bangladesh's power system published by the Bangladesh Power Development Board and the National Load Despatch Centre of the Power Grid Company of Bangladesh. They were compiled by Shisir Al Mazid, M. I. Raiyan Bin Rafik and Abdul Muttalib. The plant-level database holds 83,078 daily observations for 324 generating facilities, with station name, producer class (state utility, independent producers, public companies and cross-border links), unit configuration, installed and present capacity, daily energy and dispatcher remarks on causes of curtailment, derating or shutdown such as gas shortage, maintenance or protection trips. The master database gives 22 national daily features over 564 days, including day and evening peak generation and demand and the fuel mix. Coverage is Bangladesh from 31 December 2024 to 21 July 2026. Files are XLSX workbooks on Zenodo (September 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data are digitised from published logs by third parties, and remarks are uncurated operator text. Simulation uses are outage rate and reliability modelling, fuel supply constraint analysis and dispatch studies. Related records: data-bangladesh-pgcb-hourly-dispatch gives hourly national series.
